python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world/world.sqlite')
cur = con.cursor()
tables = cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY 1").fetchall()
print("TABLES:")
for t in tables:
    print(" ", t[0])
    cols = cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t[0]})").fetchall()
    print("   cols:", [c[1] for c in cols])
    n = cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t[0]}").fetchone()[0]
    print("   rows:", n)
